format.description: specifies the underlying output data source

options.description: key value pairs for adding output options for the underlying data source

checkpointLocation.description: file location which will be used as the checkpoint location for the current stream. (note: this is the source of truth for the stream and will be used by spark to track and recover incase of failure)

output_mode.description: Specifies how data of a streaming DataFrame is written to a streaming sink

query_name.description: specifies the name of the StreamingQuery, this must be unique per spark session

table.description: table name to which the stream will continually output results  as new data arrives

trigger.description: trigger which will define how often the stream will be executed, ONLY ONE VALUE CAN BE SET

processingTime.description: a processing time interval as a string, e.g. ‘5 seconds’, ‘1 minute’. Set a trigger that runs a microbatch query periodically based on the processing time. Only one trigger can be set.

once.description: if set to True, set a trigger that processes only one batch of data in a streaming query then terminates the query. Only one trigger can be set.

continuous.description: a time interval as a string, e.g. ‘5 seconds’, ‘1 minute’. Set a trigger that runs a continuous query with a given checkpoint interval. Only one trigger can be set. Note: a process can support only one continuous stream

availableNow.description: if set to True, set a trigger that processes all available data in multiple batches then terminates the query. Only one trigger can be set.

deequ.description: set up data quality validation for output

stopper.description: choose how to handle dq failure, hard (stop execution)
